summary.name: Hex Magic
summary.one_liner: Hex Magic is a private-beta suite of AI features inside the Hex data analytics platform that helps users write, debug, and document SQL and Python code.
use_cases: writing SQL or Python code with AI help
summary.what_it_does: The page announces Hex Magic, a suite of AI features in the Hex data platform, now in private beta. According to the post, the features help users write new SQL or Python code, get help fixing errors, and explain or document code. The author says Magic uses knowledge of database schemas, past operations, and the project's execution graph to make more specific recommendations. The post states that every code run must be manually triggered by a person, keeping a human in the loop. Sign-up is via a waitlist on the product page.
notable: Context-aware: uses database schemas, past operations, and project execution graph
Human-in-the-loop: code runs must be manually triggered
Helps with SQL and Python code, errors, and documentation
caveats: Private beta with a waitlist; not generally available yet
Pricing not stated on the page
Author says it does not replace human data work and models can make errors
